items.title: Special right to cancel contract due to price increase
items.quote:
Für diese Kündigung haben Sie drei Monate Zeit, gerechnet ab dem Zugang dieser
Mitteilung; wirksam wird sie frühestens an dem Tag, an dem der neue Preis gilt.
items.computation: The letter is dated Saturday 21.11.2026 but does not state an explicit delivery (Zugang) date. Since today (24.11.2026) is when the person has it in hand, and in the absence of a stated delivery clause the customary assumption for domestic post is used: Zugang ≈ 3 days after the printed date, i.e. 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). The 3-month period runs 'ab dem Zugang', an event-triggered period, so under §187(1) BGB the day of Zugang (24.11.2026) itself is not counted and the period begins the next day. Under §188(2) BGB a month-period triggered by an event ends on expiry of the day in the final month bearing the same calendar number as the triggering event day (24), i.e. three months after 24.11.2026 = 24.02.2027. 24.02.2027 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen, so no shift under §193 BGB applies. Final day to cancel: 24.02.2027.
